stories.title: Election présidentielle au Brésil : Lula dos au mur avant le second tour

en.title: Brazilian presidential election: Lula backs against the wall before the second round
en.summary: Lula trailed far-right candidate Flávio Bolsonaro in the first round of voting and must now persuade increasing numbers of abstainers to secure a fourth term in office.

stories.title: Le prix Nobel de médecine 2026 décerné aux chercheurs Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann et Georg Nagel, pour avoir posé "les fondements d'une nouvelle ère en neurosciences"

en.title: 2026 Nobel Prize in Medicine awarded to researchers Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel for laying "the foundations of a new era in neuroscience"
en.summary: The three researchers were honored for their discoveries concerning light-activated ion channels and optogenetics, a method that demonstrates how nerve cells shape memory, emotion and behavior in the living brain.

stories.title: Au Brésil, le candidat d'extrême droite Flavio Bolsonaro crée la surprise et devance Lula au premier tour de la présidentielle

en.title: In Brazil, far-right candidate Flavio Bolsonaro creates surprise and leads Lula in the first round of the presidential election
en.summary: The son of the former head of state secured over 47 percent of votes compared to nearly 45 percent for the incumbent president, with both candidates advancing to a second round runoff scheduled for October 25.

stories.title: 🔴 Le prix Nobel de médecine est décerné à Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann et Georg Nagel

en.title: Nobel Prize in Medicine awarded to Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel
en.summary: Three scientists were awarded the 2026 Nobel Prize in Medicine for their research contributions.

stories.title: Le Prix Nobel de médecine attribué à deux Allemands et un Américain pour leurs travaux sur l’optogénétique

en.title: Nobel Prize in Medicine Awarded to Two Germans and One American for Work on Optogenetics
en.summary: The Nobel Prize in Medicine was awarded to American Karl Deisseroth and Germans Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel for their research contributions.

stories.title: Le Nobel de médecine 2026 récompense l’Américain Karl Deisseroth et les Allemands Peter Hegemann et Georg Nagel pour leurs travaux sur les canaux ioniques

en.title: 2026 Nobel Prize in Medicine Honors American Karl Deisseroth and Germans Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel for Work on Ion Channels
en.summary: Three scientists received the Nobel Prize in Medicine for discovering a method to demonstrate how nerve cells shape memory, emotion, and behavior in the brain.

stories.title: Présidentielle au Brésil : Flavio Bolsonaro en tête du premier tour

en.title: Brazil Presidential Election: Flavio Bolsonaro Leads First Round
en.summary: Flavio Bolsonaro led the first round of Brazil's presidential election, with his family members also winning legislative seats amid a broader rightward electoral shift.

stories.title: Présidentielle au Brésil : Flavio Bolsonaro crée la surprise en devançant Lula

en.title: Brazil Presidential Election: Flavio Bolsonaro Surprises by Surpassing Lula
en.summary: Conservative senator Flavio Bolsonaro unexpectedly topped the first round of Brazil's presidential election, defeating incumbent left-wing president Lula, who will face him in a runoff on October 25.

stories.title: Flavio Bolsonaro devance Lula au Brésil, les excuses de Glucksmann à Royal, des centaines de lycées perturbés… L’actu de ce lundi 5 octobre au matin

en.title: Flavio Bolsonaro ahead of Lula in Brazil, Glucksmann's apologies to Royal, hundreds of high schools disrupted… Monday October 5 morning news
en.summary: A news digest covering Brazilian election developments, French political statements, and widespread disruptions at French secondary schools.

stories.title: EN DIRECT, blocage des lycées : 413 établissements perturbés lundi, selon le ministère de l’éducation nationale, à la veille d’une nouvelle journée de mobilisation que des syndicats appellent à rejoindre

en.title: Live: 413 schools disrupted Monday according to national education ministry, ahead of new mobilization day that unions urge participation in
en.summary: The number of disrupted French secondary schools decreased from 564 on Friday to 413 on Monday, representing a 27 percent decline, as the ministry reports ongoing dialogue with students.

stories.title: « Lula a payé le prix du mécontentement des électeurs » : au Brésil, Flavio Bolsonaro en tête au premier tour de l’élection présidentielle

en.title: "Lula paid the price for voter discontent": in Brazil, Flavio Bolsonaro leading in first round of presidential election
en.summary: The far-right candidate and son of former president Jair Bolsonaro obtained 47 percent of votes Sunday, ahead of incumbent president Lula who received 45 percent and seeks a fourth term.

stories.title: Présidentielle au Brésil : Flavio Bolsonaro devance Lula de deux points, second tour le 25 octobre

en.title: Brazilian presidential election: Flavio Bolsonaro ahead of Lula by two points, runoff on October 25
en.summary: The 45-year-old son of former far-right president Jair Bolsonaro secured 47.06 percent of votes while 80-year-old incumbent Lula received 45.12 percent in the first round.

stories.title: OPINION. « Keynes : l’État avant la panique » (Michel Santi)

en.title: OPINION. "Keynes: the State before panic" (Michel Santi)
en.summary: Keynesian economic theory is buried during periods of optimism but revived during crises, making it perpetually relevant to economic policy discussions.

stories.title: La création de zones prioritaires peut-elle endiguer le déclin du commerce de proximité ?

en.title: Can the creation of priority zones stem the decline of local retail?
en.summary: A proposed legislative measure aims to revitalize declining city centers through commercial vacancy controls, regulated rent caps, and coordinated commercial zone strategies.

stories.title: Face aux dérapages des IA américaines, la start-up Fleuret AI fait le pari d'une intelligence de cybersécurité française

en.title: Facing setbacks from American AI, start-up Fleuret AI bets on French cybersecurity intelligence
en.summary: Fleuret AI raised 4 million euros to develop autonomous AI agents for penetration testing, offering a European alternative using domestically-hosted models to U.S. tech dominance.

stories.title: Velux inaugure un nouveau bâtiment plus performant pour produire de l'aluminium dans la Somme

en.title: Velux inaugurates a new high-performance building to produce aluminum in the Somme
en.summary: Velux opened a 5,000 square meter facility at its Feuquières-en-Vimeu plant for aluminum processing, aimed at increasing production capacity and enhancing workplace conditions.

stories.title: Grande pauvreté : le mécanisme du basculement, du chômage au sans-abrisme

en.title: Extreme poverty: the mechanism of decline, from unemployment to homelessness
en.summary: An economic study based on over 16 million observations from food assistance recipients examines how people exhaust their remaining resources. When income drops and rent consumes half the budget, food aid delays unpaid bills but often cannot prevent housing loss.
